provenance.sourcePurpose: Separate public anime and public general-purpose source snapshots; no private tracker or personal library.
provenance.notes: Derived from issue6-pilot-v1: 12 works, 38 exact queries, 2010 observations. First 8 plus highest-seeder 8 per query; union preserves within-case physical identity and original query order. Counts expose omitted rows. Adult-source evidence excluded; unavailable source not empty. Public TVDB/Skyhook and TMDB identities, supplied synthetic missing episodes. Title checksums removed, opaque IDs reassigned; original IDs/links absent. Not indexer-wide recall. Proposed 8/4 split exposed during annotation, not blind evaluation. Assistant inspected all retained titles and corrected range/identity proposals. Human approved inferred-pack acceptance, named identity distractors, Blue Box mapping, and publication/provider disclosure. Targeted rubric review, not independent file verification; bracketed ambiguous claims remain uncertain.
